held.title: Waits for a yes before it is posted
held.body_one: Nothing is posted yet: no lot, no stock move, and the order has not moved. 1 line is beyond its delivery tolerance and waits for a yes; after it the receipt is posted as it was recorded.
held.body_other: Nothing is posted yet: no lot, no stock move, and the order has not moved. {count} lines are beyond their delivery tolerance and wait for a yes; after the last one the receipt is posted as it was recorded.
held.linesLabel: Lines that wait for a yes
held.why: {after} of {expected} {unit}: {more} {unit} more than expected, beyond what its delivery tolerance allows.
held.whyQuantity: {quantity} {unit} received, beyond what its delivery tolerance allows.

state.REJECTED: Refused: this receipt will not be posted
state.unread: Waits for a yes (see it in Home › Approvals)

held.refusedTitle: A line was refused: this receipt will not be posted
held.refusedBody: Cancel it, then receive the goods again within the tolerance (a correction is a new receipt).
held.releasedTitleOf: Receipt {number}: every line has its yes
held.releasedBody: It is posted by itself in a moment, for the person who recorded it. If it stays open (a closed month, a right that changed), post it here.
held.cancelledTitle: Receipt {number} is cancelled: nothing of it was posted.
held.cancelBody: Nothing of it was posted: no lot or stock move is undone. Its requests for a yes are withdrawn. To take the goods, receive them again within the tolerance.
held.reasonHint: For example: the extra pieces go back to the supplier.
held.noReceive: Only a person who receives goods at this site cancels or posts a receipt.

notice.cancelled: Receipt {number} is cancelled: its requests are withdrawn.

problem.reason: Write why it is cancelled (at most 1000 characters).
problem.held: A line still waits for its yes: the receipt is posted after the last yes.
problem.state: The receipt cannot do that now: a yes was refused, or it was posted or cancelled meanwhile. It was read again.
problem.gone: This receipt is not there any more.
problem.failed: That did not work. Try again.

docType.notSaid: Type not said (it meets any ask of its kind)
docType.title: What is {name}?
docType.body: Say what the document is, so it meets only the asks it answers: a DURC is never taken for an ISO certificate, an azo dyes report never for the chromium VI one. A document with no type still meets any ask of its kind.
docType.label: Document type
docType.hintTyped: It meets the asks of this type only.
docType.hintNone: Not said: it meets any ask of its kind, as before.
docType.typesUnread: The list of document types could not be read: try again in a moment.

held.noRight: Saying what a document is needs the right to add files at its company.

problem.code: That type is not in the list any more: choose another (it was read again).
problem.moved: The document changed meanwhile: it was read again. Check and save again.
problem.gone: This document is not current any more (replaced or removed).
problem.failed: That did not work. Try again.
